Animate shoulders, elbows and tips, not a tiny twitch. All FOUR paws remain planted, chest breathes, tail and existing flame sway. No takeoff, rearing or begging. Preserve the exact supplied creature, life stage, face, horns or crest, colours, anatomy and fine scales or feather edges. Sharp detailed sprite, no chunky enlarged pixels or blur. Fixed right-facing camera, same size and position, complete silhouette with clear canvas padding throughout. Transparent background, no floor, shadow, rider, saddle, text or new objects. Seamless loop.
